about: Rules from skills/rde/SKILL.md and references/collaboration-contract.md, checked on every rde run; "interview" names the topics of rde's questions; "files" names the working files rde's own text asks for. Edit freely: see src/session_analytics/checks.py for the check types and src/session_analytics/questions.py for the interview.

checks.desc: Before any work: reads ./.scratch/STATE.md first
Before any work: `mb --version` runs before any other mb command
Before any work: `mb auth list` runs before touching the instance
Reads references/collaboration-contract.md once per job
Loads a playbook (the route picks one per stage)
Reads a playbook before creating anything
Stops and asks (AskUserQuestion) before creating anything in Metabase
Pre-create gate: an AskUserQuestion comes before the first `mb transform create`
Pre-create gate: exactly one AskUserQuestion before the first `mb transform create`
mb conventions: --json on every mb command
mb conventions: --profile on every mb command
mb conventions: iterate with update, never delete and create
mb conventions: create/update bodies come from a file in ./.scratch (--file)
Working files go in ./.scratch, never a system temp directory (contract: working files)
Bundled mb skills: reads the one section a step names, never a whole SKILL.md (`mb skills path <name>` then Read the section)
Asks who signs off on what a number means at most once (contract: record owner and mode in STATE.md; never re-ask)
Asks where the work lands at most once (SKILL.md: ask once, record in STATE.md as environment)
Asks about personal data at most once (contract: ask once per job; apply the answer everywhere)
Every question has two or more options and one recommendation, first (contract: the checkpoint block)

match.flag: no recommendation|recommendation not first|fewer than two options

checks.desc: Questions in plain language: no grain, fact table, dimension table, surrogate key… (contract: plain language)

files.about: The working files rde's own text asks for, all in ./.scratch (references/collaboration-contract.md: working files go in ./.scratch, never a system temp directory): STATE.md and the probe helper q() (references/state.md), a model's SQL and description (playbooks/build-clean-tables.md), the JSON bodies mb reads with --file, transform-test SQL and CSV extracts (references/transform-tests.md, references/profiling-catalog.md). `match` is a regular expression on the path, relative to the project. A file a run creates that none of these match — and that is not Claude Code's memory — is a support file: a script, a list of ids, a saved response, made to do what the skill did not.

expected.label: A model's SQL or transform-test SQL
A JSON body mb reads with --file

interview.about: What rde's questions are about, in its own terms: SKILL.md (the pre-create gate, where the work lands) and references/collaboration-contract.md (owner and mode, checkpoints, personal data, the decision memo, the hand-back). Topics are tried in order; the first whose `match` finds the header or question wins. `once`: the skill says ask it once per job and never again. `evidence`: a decision the contract wants measured numbers behind ('profile first, then ask'). `prose: avoid`: stops belong in AskUserQuestion, not in prose. `must_ask`: the skill requires the question (a pre-create gate item or an irreversible stop), so an always-accepted recommendation is not a reason to stop asking it.

topics.label: Working files: keep a copy
topics.match: working files|save a copy|keep a copy|temporary folder

topics.label: Sign-off: who owns what a number means (sets autonomy)
Where the work lands: production, staging or sandbox
Personal data: shown, masked or counts only
Freshness: pinned to the extract or to today
Existing build: replace, supersede or alongside
The decision memo: accept the defaults or review them
Publish or go live (irreversible)
topics.match: publish|move out of drafts|ready to|canonical|library|verified|go live

topics.label: What to build first or next
